scenarios.title: A｜修改入住日期
scenarios.setting: 在“修改预订 Changing a Reservation”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“修改入住日期”。

turns.text: Good afternoon, Grand Park Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to change my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to change my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

words: I'd like to change my reservation.
I'd like to change my check-in date.
from... to...
Are those dates available?

choices.text: Hi, I need to make a change to my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I need to make a change to my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Hi, I want to change my booking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I want to change my booking.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: Hi, I want change my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to change my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Of course. May I have your name and reservation number?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. It’s under Alex Chen, and the reservation number is 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s under Alex Chen, and the reservation number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: The booking is under Alex Chen. My reservation number is 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: The booking is under Alex Chen. My reservation number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: My reservation name is Alex Chen.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s under Alex Chen, and the reservation number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: 能听懂预订姓名，但更常说“the reservation is under + 姓名”；编号也可一起提供，便于查询。

choices.text: My reservation number are 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s under Alex Chen, and the reservation number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: 一个预订编号用单数“reservation number”，因此搭配“is”；也可以直接报出编号。

turns.text: Thank you. I found your reservation. What would you like to change?

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to change my check-in date from October 12th to October 14th.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change my check-in date from October 12th to October 14th.
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Can I move my check-in date to October 14th?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I move my check-in date to October 14th?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I’d like to arrive two days later.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change my check-in date from October 12th to October 14th.
feedback.explanation: 这句自然，但“两天后”需要双方对原日期理解一致；涉及改期时，直接核对新旧日期更稳妥。

choices.text: I want change the date to October 14th.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change my check-in date from October 12th to October 14th.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

choices.text: I’d like to change to a double room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change my check-in date from October 12th to October 14th.
feedback.explanation: 这句要改房型；当前需要修改的是入住日期，需说清原日期和新日期。

turns.text: Let me check. Yes, we have a room available from October 14th to the 16th.

turns.prompt: 你想确认新的入住日期，并请前台修改预订，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Can you change my reservation to those dates?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Can you change my reservation to those dates?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Perfect. I’d like to change it to October 14th to the 16th.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’d like to change it to October 14th to the 16th.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Great. Those dates work for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Those dates work for me.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Okay, please change my reservation on those dates.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Can you change my reservation to those dates?
feedback.explanation: 把预订改到某日期用“change … to those dates”；“on those dates”容易被理解为在那些日期进行修改。

turns.text: Certainly. Your reservation has been updated.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thanks. Could you send me an updated confirmation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Could you send me an updated confirmation?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Perfect, thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect, thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

learningGoals: I'd like to change my reservation.
I'd like to change my check-in date.
from... to...
Are those dates available?

scenarios.title: B｜修改入住人数
scenarios.setting: 在“修改预订 Changing a Reservation”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“修改入住人数”。

turns.text: I found your reservation. What would you like to change?

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to change the number of guests.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change the number of guests.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

words: I'd like to change the number of guests.
There will be three of us.
Can I add another guest?
Is there an extra charge?

choices.text: I need to add another guest to my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to add another guest to my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: One more person will be staying with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: One more person will be staying with me.
feedback.explanation: “more / extra / another”表示在已有数量上增加，能说明是补充需求。

choices.text: I want to add one people.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change the number of guests.
feedback.explanation: 说一个人用“one person”，“people”通常表示多人；人数说清后，工作人员才好修改记录。

turns.text: No problem. How many guests will there be in total?

turns.prompt: 你想确认或说明人数、数量，会怎么说？

choices.text: There will be three of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: There will be three of us.
feedback.explanation: “There will be … of us”说明同行总人数，适合预订时确认需要安排多少人。

choices.text: There will be three guests in total.

feedback.naturalExpression: There will be three guests in total.
feedback.explanation: “in total”指合计，强调所有项目加在一起的数额。

choices.text: The room will be for three people.

feedback.naturalExpression: The room will be for three people.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: We will have three people.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: There will be three of us.
feedback.explanation: 能理解人数，但“There will be three of us”更直接表示同行共有三人，而不只是泛泛说会有三个人。

choices.text: There will be three person.

feedback.naturalExpression: There will be three of us.
feedback.explanation: 表示多个人时通常说“people”，例如“three people”；不能在数词后仍用单数“person”。

turns.text: That’s fine. Your room can accommodate up to three guests.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: Is there an extra charge for the third guest?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there an extra charge for the third guest?
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: Will I have to pay extra?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I have to pay extra?
feedback.explanation: “pay extra”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: Does it cost extra to add another guest?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does it cost extra to add another guest?
feedback.explanation: “cost extra”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: Need I pay more money?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there an extra charge for the third guest?
feedback.explanation: “Need I …?”语法上可以成立，但较正式；日常询问附加费常说“Do I need to pay extra?”。

turns.text: Yes, there’s an additional charge of $25 per night.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s fine. Please add the third guest to my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Please add the third guest to my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Okay, that works for me. Please update the reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that works for me. Please update the reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: That’s okay. I’ll pay the extra charge.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. I’ll pay the extra charge.
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: Okay, add one people please.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Please add the third guest to my reservation.
feedback.explanation: 说一个人用“one person”，“people”通常表示多人；人数说清后，工作人员才好修改记录。

turns.text: Done. Your reservation is now for three guests.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great, thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

learningGoals: I'd like to change the number of guests.
There will be three of us.
Can I add another guest?
Is there an extra charge?

scenarios.title: C｜修改房型
scenarios.setting: 在“修改预订 Changing a Reservation”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“修改房型”。

turns.text: What would you like to change about your reservation?

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to change my room type.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change my room type.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

words: I'd like to change my room type.
Can I change from... to...?
Is there a ... available?
How much extra would that be?

choices.text: I’d like to change to a different room type.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change to a different room type.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I want a different kind of room.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change my room type.
feedback.explanation: 这句意思明确；“room type”是谈房型的常用搭配，“I’d like to change …”还点明是在修改已有预订。

choices.text: I want change my room type.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change my room type.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Certainly. You currently have a twin room. What would you prefer?

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can I change from a twin room to a double room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I change from a twin room to a double room?
feedback.explanation: “twin room”指有两张分开的床的房间，区别于通常配一张双人床的“double room”。

choices.text: I’d like to switch to a double room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to switch to a double room.
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: Do you have a double room available instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a double room available instead?
feedback.explanation: “double room available”是在问有没有可订的双人房；“available”把重点放在余房，而不只是酒店有没有这种房型。

choices.text: Can you change my twin room become double room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I change from a twin room to a double room?
feedback.explanation: “change … become …”不能这样连接；从一种房型换成另一种，可用“change from … to …”。

turns.text: Yes, we have a double room available, but it’s $20 more per night.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: So how much would the double room be per night?

feedback.naturalExpression: So how much would the double room be per night?
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: How much extra would that be in total?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much extra would that be in total?
feedback.explanation: “in total”指合计，强调所有项目加在一起的数额。

choices.text: What’s the total price with the upgrade?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the total price with the upgrade?
feedback.explanation: “total price”关注最终总价，适合核对是否还存在附加费用。

choices.text: How much more money I need pay?

feedback.naturalExpression: So how much would the double room be per night?
feedback.explanation: “need”后接动作时通常用“need to + 动词原形”。补上“to”，才能把“需要”和具体动作连接起来。

turns.text: It would be $140 per night, or $280 for your two-night stay.

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: That’s fine. I’d like to switch to the double room.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’d like to switch to the double room.
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: Okay, I’ll take the double room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll take the double room.
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: That works for me. Please change the room type.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me. Please change the room type.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: No, thanks. I’ll keep the twin room.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, thanks. I’ll keep the twin room.
feedback.explanation: 先谢绝升级，再用“keep”明确保留原来的双床房，能避免工作人员误改预订。

turns.text: Certainly. I’ve updated your reservation.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Perfect. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

learningGoals: I'd like to change my room type.
Can I change from... to...?
Is there a ... available?
How much extra would that be?

scenarios.title: D｜申请提前入住
scenarios.setting: 在“修改预订 Changing a Reservation”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“申请提前入住”。

turns.text: How can I help you with your reservation?

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to request early check-in, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to request early check-in, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

words: I'd like to request early check-in.
I'll be arriving around...
Would it be possible to check in early?
Is there an extra charge?

choices.text: Would it be possible to check in early?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to check in early?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Can I request an early check-in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I request an early check-in?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I want to check in more early.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to request early check-in, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “early / late”的比较级是“earlier / later”，不用“more early / more late”；“later”前也不再加“more”。

turns.text: Our normal check-in time is 3 p.m. What time will you be arriving?

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ll be arriving around 11 a.m.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll be arriving around 11 a.m.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I expect to arrive at about 11 in the morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I expect to arrive at about 11 in the morning.
feedback.explanation: “I expect”说明预期情况，语气比单纯猜测更确定，但仍区别于已发生的事实。

choices.text: My flight arrives at 9, so I’ll probably get to the hotel around 11.

feedback.naturalExpression: My flight arrives at 9, so I’ll probably get to the hotel around 11.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I will arrive in 11 a.m.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll be arriving around 11 a.m.
feedback.explanation: 具体钟点前用“at”，大约几点可用“around”；这里不说“in 11 a.m.”。

turns.text: We can’t guarantee that your room will be ready by 11, but we’ll do our best.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: I understand. Is there an extra charge for early check-in?

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Is there an extra charge for early check-in?
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: That’s fine. Would I need to pay extra?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Would I need to pay extra?
feedback.explanation: “pay extra”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: Okay. Does early check-in cost extra?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Does early check-in cost extra?
feedback.explanation: “cost extra”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: Early check-in need more money?

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Is there an extra charge for early check-in?
feedback.explanation: 应使用完整问句，如“Does early check-in cost extra?”；“need more money”没有清楚表达酒店收费。

turns.text: No, there’s no extra charge if the room is already available.

turns.prompt: 你想请前台在预订中备注提前入住的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Could you add the request to my reservation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you add the request to my reservation?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Okay. Could you make a note on my reservation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you make a note on my reservation?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Perfect. Please add the early check-in request.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Please add the early check-in request.
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Okay, please write it in my booking.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you add the request to my reservation?

turns.text: Certainly. I’ve added the request. Just keep in mind that early check-in isn’t guaranteed.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No problem. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Thank you for your help.

choices.text: I understand. Thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: That’s fine. I’ll check when I arrive.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’ll check when I arrive.

scenarios.title: E｜申请延迟退房
scenarios.setting: 在“修改预订 Changing a Reservation”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“申请延迟退房”。

turns.text: How can I help you today?

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to request late check-out.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to request late check-out.
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

words: I'd like to request late check-out.
Would it be possible to check out at...?
Can I stay until...?
Is there an additional charge?

choices.text: Would it be possible to check out later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to check out later?
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Can I arrange a late check-out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I arrange a late check-out?
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: I want to check out more late.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to request late check-out.
feedback.explanation: “early / late”的比较级是“earlier / later”，不用“more early / more late”；“later”前也不再加“more”。

turns.text: Our normal check-out time is 11 a.m. What time would you like to leave?

turns.prompt: 你想办理入住、出行或离店手续，会怎样说明来意？

choices.text: Would it be possible to check out at 2 p.m.?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to check out at 2 p.m.?
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Could I stay until 2 p.m.?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I stay until 2 p.m.?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I’d like to check out around 2, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to check out around 2, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Can I check out in 2 p.m.?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to check out at 2 p.m.?
feedback.explanation: 具体钟点通常用“at”，如“at 2 p.m.”；“in”通常用于月份、年份或一段时间之后。

choices.text: I want stay more three hours.

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to check out at 2 p.m.?
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Yes, we can offer late check-out until 2 p.m.

turns.prompt: 你想确认延迟退房是否收费，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is there an additional charge for that?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there an additional charge for that?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: How much does late check-out cost?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much does late check-out cost?
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Will I have to pay extra?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I have to pay extra?
feedback.explanation: “pay extra”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: Do I need to pay extra money for it?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is there an additional charge for that?
feedback.explanation: 这句语法正确、意思明确；“pay extra”已能表达额外付费，通常不必再补“money”。

choices.text: Does it need extra charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there an additional charge for that?
feedback.explanation: “charge”作为一项费用需要冠词，且常说“Is there an extra charge?”；这里不是物品本身“需要费用”。

turns.text: There’s a $30 late check-out fee.

turns.prompt: 关于「修改预订」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: That’s fine. I’d like to add late check-out to my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’d like to add late check-out to my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Okay, that works for me. Please add it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that works for me. Please add it.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Sure. I’ll take the late check-out.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’d like to add late check-out to my reservation.
feedback.explanation: 可以这样接受安排；若想确保前台正式登记，补充“add late check-out to my reservation”会更清楚。

choices.text: That’s too much. I’ll check out at 11 instead.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s too much. I’ll check out at 11 instead.
feedback.explanation: 先说明加价超出接受范围，再确认按原时间退房，给出明确决定。

turns.text: Certainly. Your check-out time has been changed to 2 p.m.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great, thanks. That really helps.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks. That really helps.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。
